Lemma 4.1: $\mathcal{T}_{\mathbb{C}}$ Multiplication ident
nodes.statement:
Let $\alpha, \beta \in \mathbb{C}^\times$, and $a, b, u, v$ be positive integers. Then for $k, j \in \mathbb{Z}$ and any complete residue system $R$ of integers modulo $au^2+bv^2$, one has
\begin{equation} 
    \big[{\alpha x^a};{k}\big](u z) \cdot \big[{\beta x^b};{j}\big](v z) = 
    \sum_{\ell \in R} M_\ell(q) \big[{\alpha^u \beta^v q^{a\binom{u}{2} + b \binom{v}{2}} x^{au^2+bv^2}};{\ell}\big],
\end{equation}
where the coefficients $M_\ell(q) \in \mathbb{C}$ also depend on $a, b, \alpha, \beta, u, v$ but not on $z$, and are computed as follows. Let $d := \gcd(au, bv)$, $a' := au/d$, $b' := bv/d$ and $\ell' := (\ell - uk - vj)/d$. If $\ell' \not\in \mathbb{Z}$, then $M_\ell(q) = 0$. Else, letting $(n_0, m_0)$ be an integer solution to $a'n_0 + b'm_0 = 1$, one has
\begin{equation} 
    M_\ell(q)
    =
    \gamma_\ell \sum_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} 
    \big(\alpha^{b'} \beta^{-a'}\big)^n 
    q^{\frac{ab'^2 + ba'^2}{2}n^2 + \delta_\ell n},
\end{equation}
\[
    \gamma_\ell = \big( \alpha^{n_0} \beta^{m_0} \big)^{\ell'} q^{a\binom{n_0 \ell' }{2} + b\binom{m_0 \ell'}{2} + (kn_0 + jm_0)\ell'},
    \qquad\quad
    \delta_\ell 
    =
    (ab'n_0 - ba'm_0)\ell' - \frac{ab' - ba'}{2} + kb' - ja'.
    
\]

nodes.name: Proposition 5.4: 2-Var Rog --Ram variation Prop
nodes.statement:
In $\mathcal{T}_{\mathbb{H}^{\textnormal{-}\hspace{-0.03cm}}}\left(qx^2 - q^{-1}\right)$, one has
\[
    \frac{(q; q)\left\langle x; q\right\rangle (qx; q)}{(-q; q)^2\left(- x^{-1}; q\right)}
    
    =
    2\left(-q^2; q^2\right) \big[{qx^2 - q^{-1}};{0}\big]
    - \left(-q; q^2\right)\big[{qx^2 - q^{-1}};{1}\big].

\]

nodes.name: Theorem 5.11: $\mathcal{T}_{\mathbb{C}}$ Change-of-basis ident Thm
nodes.statement:
Let $\alpha, y \in \mathbb{C}$ with $\alpha \neq 0$, and $d \in \mathbb{Z}$ with $d \ge 2$. Define the $d \times d$ matrices $U = (U_{k, \ell})_{0 \le k, \ell < d}$ and $W = (W_{k, \ell})_{0 \le k, \ell < d}$ by
\[
    U_{k, \ell} := \sum_{n \ge \mathbbm{1}_{\ell > k}} \alpha^n \frac{q^{d\binom{n}{2} + kn}}{(q; q)_{dn+k-\ell}} y^{dn+k-\ell}, 
    \qquad 
    W_{k, \ell} := \sum_{n \ge \mathbbm{1}_{\ell > k}} \alpha^n \frac{q^{\binom{d}{2}n^2 + (d(k-\ell-1)+\ell)n + \binom{k - \ell}{2}}}{(q; q)_{dn+k-\ell}} (-y)^{dn+k-\ell}.
\]
Then one has $\det U = \det W = 1$. Moreover,
\[
    W U = 
    \begin{psmall} 
    1 & 0 & \cdots & 0 & -\alpha y q^{-1}
    \\
    0 & 1 & \cdots & 0 & 0 
    \\
    & & & \ddots & \\
    0 & 0 & \cdots & 0 & 1
    \end{psmall}
    \qquad 
    \text{and}
    \qquad 
    W = \prod_{n \ge 0} M\left(q^n y\right),
\]
where $M$ is as in 5.10 and the product of matrices is evaluated from left to right.

nodes.name: Theorem 1.3: Septuple to Rog --Ram proportionality Thm
nodes.statement:
For $0 < |q| < 1$, one has 
\[
    
    
    
    -\frac{\left\langle x^2; q\right\rangle}{(qx; q)} 
    \ =\  
    \frac{\big[{-qx^5};{1}\big] + \big[{-qx^5};{2}\big]}{\big[{qx^2 - x};{0}\big]} \ =\  \frac{\big[{-qx^5};{0}\big] + \big[{-qx^5};{3}\big]}{\big[{qx^2 - x};{1}\big]},
\]
as an identity of meromorphic functions of $z \in \mathbb{C}$ (where $x = e^{2\pi i z}$). The left-hand side above equals minus the ratio of the septuple product in 1.3 to the product in 1.2.

nodes.name: Theorem 1.4: Octuple to Rog --Ram proportionality Thm
nodes.statement:
For $0 < |q| < 1$, one has
\[
    
    
    -\frac{\left(-x^{-1}; q\right) \left\langle x; q\right\rangle \left\langle qx^2; q^2 \right\rangle }{(q; q^2)(qx; q)} 
    \ =\ \frac{\big[{-qx^4};{1}\big]}{\big[{qx^2 - q^{-1}};{0}\big]} \ =\  \frac{\big[{-qx^4};{0}\big] + \big[{-qx^4};{2}\big]}{\big[{qx^2 - q^{-1}};{1}\big]},
\]
as an identity of meromorphic functions of $z \in \mathbb{C}$ (where $x = e^{2\pi i z}$). The left-hand side above equals minus the ratio of the octuple product in 4.13 to the product in 5.4. Here, $\big[{qx^2 - q^{-1}};{k}\big] \in \mathcal{T}_{\mathbb{H}^{\textnormal{-}\hspace{-0.03cm}}}\left( qx^2 - q^{-1}\right)$ are defined analogously to $\big[{qx^2 - x};{k}\big]$ in 1.2.

nodes.name: Corollary 1.5, Section 4.2: Ident of generalized eta functions Cor §
nodes.statement:
For $\tau \in {\mathbb{H}}^+$, let $\textnormal E_g(\tau)$ denote the generalized eta functions of level $N = 7$. Then one has the polynomial factorization
\[
    X^3
    - 2\frac{\eta(14\tau)^2}{\eta(7\tau)^2} X^2
    - \frac{\eta(2\tau)\eta(7\tau)^3}{\eta(\tau)\eta(14\tau)^3} X
    + \frac{\eta(\tau)\eta(14\tau)}{\eta(2\tau)\eta(7\tau)}
    = \prod_{g = 1}^3 \left(X - \frac{\textnormal E_{g}(2\tau)}{\textnormal E_{3g}(\tau)}\right).
\]
